name: 60607 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60607 (Chicago) has 302 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 107 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60607 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 arts and cultural organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through arts and cultural groups? Where else does that happen?
